MP_RULE_MISSING_DATA: The multiplayer map or multiplayer constants are missing.
MP_RULE_UNSUPPORTED_GAME_TYPE: The map has an unsupported game type.
MP_RULE_INVALID_FORCED_TECH_LEVEL: The map's forced tech level is outside MultiplayerConsts.TechLevels.
MP_RULE_INVALID_TECH_LEVEL: Select a valid multiplayer tech level.
MP_RULE_INVALID_ALLOWED_NATION: The map's allowed nations contain an invalid MultiplayerConsts side index.
MP_RULE_NO_AVAILABLE_NATION: No allowed nation is available at this tech level.
MP_RULE_INVALID_LOBBY_CAPACITY: The lobby requires at least two human slots and cannot exceed the map's player limit.
MP_RULE_COOP_INVALID_PLAYER_LAYOUT: COOP maps require at most 16 map players, with the neutral player last.
MP_RULE_COOP_INVALID_PLAYER_ROLES: COOP players must be HUMAN on side 0 or AI_BOT on side 1, followed by one neutral.
MP_RULE_COOP_INSUFFICIENT_HUMAN_SLOTS: The COOP map declares more human slots than its HUMAN players provide.
MP_RULE_LOBBY_SETTINGS_MISMATCH: The lobby settings do not match the map's rules.
MP_RULE_INVALID_PLAYER_ASSIGNMENT: A player occupies an unavailable slot, team or nation.
MP_RULE_PLAYERS_NOT_READY: Every player must be ready before starting.
MP_RULE_INVALID_PLAYER_COLOUR: A player has selected an unavailable colour.
CANT_START_COOP_PLAYERS:
At least two human players are required.

CANT_START_SAME_TEAM: All players have the same team. The game will not start.
MP_JOIN_INVALID_HUMAN_SLOT: The host assigned an unavailable human player slot.
